unsupported: Southwest Decoratives & Kokopelli Quilting Company operates from Bernalillo, New Mexico, where it has been based since relocating from Albuquerque.
The business was founded in 1992 by Mary-Jo McCarthy as a home-based venture selling Southwestern-themed quilt patterns through a small black-and-white catalog.
It remains family-owned, with McCarthy and her family running the operation.
The store moved to its current location on US Highway 550 in Bernalillo, where it also serves wholesale buyers.
Inventory includes cotton prints, block-of-the-month programs, clothing patterns, and craft supplies.
Customers include individual quilters, sewists, and crafters across the United States, Canada, and Europe, as well as other retail shops purchasing wholesale.

Known for: Family-owned since 1992; Online sales since 1994; Voted Top 10 quilt shop by Better Homes & Gardens (2013); Free shipping on orders over $200; Specializes in Southwestern-themed fabrics and patterns
